title: Talking
summary: Identify jaw movements caused by speech.
purpose: Collect speech without food as hard negatives.

request.summary: Speech moves the jaw and is a known chewing confound.

preparation: Wear both AirPods and confirm they are connected to this iPhone.
Prop the iPhone so your face and jaw are visible.
Use steady, even lighting on your face.
Stay within the camera view for the whole recording.
Think of something to talk about for about a minute.

camera.position: Prop the iPhone upright at face height, about an arm's length away, front camera facing you with face and jaw visible.

activities.instruction: Look at the camera and nod distinctly
activities.expected_behavior: One clear nod visible in video and AirPods motion; mouth still
One clear nod visible in video and AirPods motion; mouth still
